summary.text: John Simmons is a Republican state representative who has represented Missouri House of Representatives District 109 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. A chiropractic physician, he previously represented the district from 2019 to 2023.

paragraphs.text: Simmons earned a degree from Logan University in 1991, and his career experience includes working as a chiropractic physician.
He previously represented District 109 in the Missouri House from 2019 to 2023 and returned to the seat on January 8, 2025.
For the 2025-2026 session, he was assigned to the House General Laws Committee and the Joint Committee on Tax Policy.
